description: This file defines the FailoverError class and related functions for handling failover error logic, including error classification, property extraction, and error coercion.

classes.name: FailoverError
classes.description: Custom error class representing a failover error with additional context such as reason, provider, model, profileId, status, and code.

methods.name: isFailoverError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is an instance of FailoverError.

methods.name: resolveFailoverStatus
methods.description: Maps a FailoverReason to an HTTP status code.

methods.name: resolveFailoverReasonFromError
methods.description: Determines the FailoverReason from an error object.

methods.name: describeFailoverError
methods.description: Provides a descriptive object for a failover error, including message, reason, status, and code.

methods.name: coerceToFailoverError
methods.description: Converts a generic error into a FailoverError, adding context if necessary.
